calibrated_on: ubuntu-latest (GitHub Actions), Ruby 4.0.8, rbs 4.2.0, release-gate run 39886264420 (release/0.4.6 @ d79137fd1)
note: Linux CI measurements of the v0.4.6 release candidate (release/0.4.6, release-gate run 39886264420) over the frozen corpus v0.4.5, recalibrated on the same corpus on the maintainer's ruling of 2026-10-23: cut #2295's cost first (done in #2329) and accept the remainder. The first candidate run (39877263262) failed at 81,867,757 allocations (+37.6% vs 59,515,347); per-PR A/B attribution named #2295 (callee-chain mutation floor) for +19,922,478 (+31.21%), and #2329 (callee-chain census memo) removed it. This run reads 62,078,564 allocations (+4.31% over the previous baseline), wall_s 41.56, peak_rss_kb 632,152. wall_s is not the artifact's: the run 39886264420 artifact's wall_s of 41.56 was a fast-runner outlier, and this release's runs measured 41.6 to 74.7 s on the same engine, so on the maintainer's ruling wall_s keeps the previous baseline's 56.472 (a 68 s ceiling) while allocations and peak_rss_kb come from that run. The remaining rise is engine cost from this cycle's PRs, the largest per-PR deltas being #2285 +711,276, #2301 +616,021, #2264 +507,320, #2288 +291,831 and #2202 +274,785, then #2199 +101,978, #2221 +99,866, #2225 +84,637 and #2263 +75,206; every other PR moved it by less than about 30k. Ruby moved from 4.0.7 to 4.0.8 (CI floats ruby-version 4.0) and gems are unchanged (rbs 4.2.0), and the per-PR deltas sum to the observed rise, so the Ruby patch is not material. diagnostics moves from 1 to 3: #2221 lets a declared ivar type win over the writes, and the v0.4.5 tree's sig declared optimistic_locals / optimistic_ivars as Hash[Symbol, Symbol | Data], so Scope#optimistic_local and #optimistic_ivar report def.return-type-mismatch on that tree; master's sig has since tightened the declaration. The previous baseline (run 39187976225, the v0.4.5 engine on corpus v0.4.5) read 59,515,347 allocations, wall_s 56.472, peak_rss_kb 575,716. The band is a budget for the engine cost added since this calibration. After the v0.4.6 release the corpus advances to the new tag. bench/README.md and the rigor-release-prep skill carry the procedures. Sampling rule (#987): each gate run takes 2 reps per target, EACH IN A FRESH PROCESS, and records the LOWER of the reps for wall_s and peak_rss_kb while allocations and diagnostics are taken from the first rep unreduced; baseline.updated.json is already reduced.
